title: I Let the Drill-Battery Gauge Catch the Member Who Returned Packs at One Bar

parts.text: I let the drill-battery gauge catch the member at 6:22 p.m. who returned packs at one bar. The board said RETURN AT THREE. I was thirty, member, standing at a rack that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the one-bar still, the board, and the checkout name. The desk held the packs until they hit three. I keep the gauge photo. The rack finally knows three bars from one.

social.video_title: They returned the drill packs at one bar — Part 1/1
